title: Conserved content moves only through a boundary or an exchange

statements.text: By Stokes' theorem the net current through the boundary of any compact region vanishes, so content can be redistributed inside a region but cannot appear or disappear without a boundary or exchange route. Homologous surfaces carry the same integrated content.

sources.quote: What it cannot do is appear or disappear without a corresponding boundary or exchange route.
Homologous hypersurfaces therefore carry the same integrated content.
